mandatory_gaps_and_warnings: The repository does not prove that every conceivable historical market field exists. Missing PIT publication/first-seen/revision/depth/fill/corporate-action evidence must remain missing, never reconstructed from future information.
2023-2026 history has been exposed to prior research and cannot be called pristine holdout.
Daily EOD mother folders in the current repo cover only the listed 2026 dates; longer historical PIT evidence is stored in research datasets/payloads and must be lineage-audited before use.
Q017 old schema-v5 09:01/Top3/DXY semantics and current canonical Q017 are different contracts; do not silently blend them.
Actual user trades and no-fill reports are execution-state evidence, not model labels for retrospective optimization.
Any unreadable/corrupt historical payload must be recorded as a failed input, not silently repaired unless source-equivalent bytes can be independently proven.
